 K-Beauty Retailer Olive Young Will Open Five Stores in California in 2027
 Customers can shop a curated selection of Korean beauty brands while exploring sun sticks, sun cushions and toner pads. 
 November 12, 2026 
 By: Lianna Albrizio 
 Associate Editor , Happi 
 Save 
 A rendering of Olive Young's new store location at Irvine Spectrum Center in California. 
 Image caption -->
 With the K-beauty wave getting bigger in the US, its popular retailer, Olive Young, will open five new stores in California in the first half of 2027.
 The move will bring its total US store count to seven as it accelerates efforts to expand K-beauty’s reach in the market. The new stores will be located across Greater Los Angeles and San Diego.
 In Greater Los Angeles, Olive Young plans to open stores at four major shopping destinations: Irvine Spectrum Center; Del Amo Fashion Center; Bloom on Third; and Brea Mall.
 The retailer will also expand into San Diego with a store at Fashion Valley, one of the city’s premier shopping destinations, further extending its retail presence across Southern California.
 Customers can shop a curated selection of trusted Korean beauty brands while exploring innovative product formats such as sun sticks, sun cushions and toner pads. Through hands-on product experiences and guidance on building effective skincare routines, the stores offer a deeper understanding of what makes K-beauty distinctive.
 The Skin Scan Experience
 A key part of the shopping experience is Skin Scan, Olive Young’s in-store skin analysis service. The service allows customers to better understand their skin condition and discover K-beauty products and skincare routines tailored to their individual concerns. The personalized service has received an “enthusiastic” response from US consumers, the brand said, attracting approximately 27,000 users within five months of the company’s first store opening, as of October.
